_comment: The submission video, one entry per beat of tests/demo.spec.ts. scripts/make-video.mjs speaks each line with Piper (or plays a beat's own 'audio'), the demo waits for each line to finish before the next beat, and the captions are burned in ('captions' times are seconds into the beat or clip). The 'say' beat's 'mic' is played into the browser's microphone, so the real Amazon Transcribe hears exactly what the video plays. 'open' is real footage before the title card; its files live in .video/source, outside the repository (the edit runs without them).
title: SpatialDesk
subtitle: A workspace should adapt to the person. Say what is hard today: an AI agent reshapes your space to your body and your mind, and you can undo any step.
end_line: Your body. Your mind. Your space. Open it on a Quest: no install, no account.

captions.text:
Hoy me duele mucho el cuello.
My neck hurts a lot today.

Y estoy cansada.
And I'm tired.

beats.text: Spatial apps expect you to turn your head, reach out and pinch the air. On a bad day, she can't. So SpatialDesk adapts to her.
She presses Talk, and says it in her own words.
Hoy me duele mucho el cuello, y estoy cansada. Acércalo todo por la derecha, y la letra más grande, por favor.

captions.text:

And I'm tired.

Acércalo todo por la derecha
Bring everything closer, on the right,

y la letra más grande, por favor.
and the text bigger, please.

beats.text: Amazon Transcribe hears her Spanish. The agent, a specialist in ergonomics, answers with changes to her space, each with its reason.
One tap. Everything comes closer and larger, on her right, within a small turn of her neck. Every change has its own undo.
Then her day, written in plain words. Amazon Nova plans it, and the same Kotlin engine that runs in the headset checks every step.
Nothing changes until she says yes.
When her hands are tired, she looks at a button and holds her gaze. Where the headset tracks the eyes, her eyes alone are enough.
Starting is the hardest part. Start small turns her first task into five minutes.
Five minutes later she has started, so the agent offers to keep going, not a break.
A small companion works beside her board. If her mind wanders, it calls her back, gently.
Every change the agent made is in the AI log, with its reason and its own undo.
On a Quest 3 it works in her real room. Fit room stands her board on her real desk, and in a focus block the room recedes.
And it is ready for Meta VR Glasses: the layout fits their narrower view, and she just looks and pinches.
Your body. Your mind. Your space. SpatialDesk adapts to you. Open the link: there is nothing to install.
